name: remoteid-web
description: Drone Remote ID (ASTM F3411 / EN 4709-002) capture analysis in the browser and Node: decodes pcap, pcapng and RIDF captures and reports per-transmitter trust verdicts (spoofing, plausibility) from the Rust remoteid crates, compiled to WebAssembly.
author: Matt Busel <matt@busel.dev>
